coordinate_system: Original source image resized uniformly by 1/4 from 3840x2160; x rightward, y downward; frame indices are zero based. Landing point approximates cork/floor contact; trajectory points approximate visible shuttle center.
reference_inspection_method: Original source sequential frames and native crops decoded from frame 0 with OpenCV VideoCapture two threads. No frame seeking. No pipeline predictions or previous AI annotations were inspected. Both original camera views were inspected independently and cross-checked by rally sequence.

later_bounce_observations.notes: Second floor contact after the first rebound; clear cork turning/rebound in consecutive native crops.

notes: AI visual estimate, not human ground truth.

The main-court shuttle falls into the foreground between the net and the near dark-green-shirt player. The main pair in this view are the white-shirt and dark-green-shirt players; the active players farther right belong to the adjacent court.

Motion blur and the pale floor reduce contrast immediately before the first contact. Native consecutive source crops show the downward motion reversing between frames 186 and 187, followed by a long small rebound.
The later contact around frame 214 and the subsequent shuttle on the floor must not replace the first landing near frame 186.
